verdict.rationale: Secureframe offers automated alerts/notifications tied to specific built-in events (failing tests, overdue tasks, recurring reviews) and integrations to sync follow-up tasks to ticketing tools, which is a limited form of event-triggered automation, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose rule/trigger builder where users define arbitrary custom conditions-to-actions logic. Missing for 10: a documented rules engine or workflow builder allowing arbitrary event conditions and custom actions, evidence of user-defined trigger logic beyond fixed monitoring/notification types, independent corroboration of this capability.
